mentions.name: Tapitalee
mentions.description: A platform for deploying containerized apps to the user's own AWS account with minimal configuration. It includes a CLI tool with instant console sessions, instant SQL/Redis provisioning with Heroku-like add-ons, and enterprise features such as autoscaling, preview apps, audit trails, and release approvals.
mentions.audience: Developers and enterprises deploying containerized apps to their own AWS accounts
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on https://tapitalee.com

  - Deploy containerized apps to your own AWS account with minimal config!
  - CLI tool with instant console sessions
  - Set up SQL/Redis instantly with Heroku-like add-ons.
  - For enterprise: Autoscaling, preview apps, audit trail, release approvals.

mentions.name: Tapitalee
mentions.description: This deployment platform lets users deploy any containerized app to their own AWS account with minimal configuration, running on Fargate instead of Kubernetes. It offers a Heroku-like CLI with instant console sessions, instant SQL/Redis add-ons, autoscaling, preview apps, an audit trail, and release approvals.
